q: Which products are profitable after returns and advertising costs?

checks.what: tool: returns and ad cost covered

answer:
Short answer: In the last 30 days (order-date product net profit), many products are profitable after returns and allocated ad spend — top ones include Pawveralls Pro Suspender Boots (₹71,840), PawTech Cleaner with Paw Cleanser 500ml (₹22,920), WingBird Smart Flapping Toy (₹14,696), Meow Scratch Lounge (₹14,365) and WildTrail Boots (₹10,114). These are product net profit (allocated) = net sales − net COGS − allocated ad spend (product view, order-date).

What changed / why it matters:
- Highest contributors: Pawveralls Pro Suspender Boots leads at ₹71,840 net profit in the period; it's the single biggest product profit line and drives margin.  
- Mid-tier winners: several toys, cleaners and boot SKUs each contribute ~₹10k–₹23k; these are profitable after returns + allocated ads and can scale without immediately hurting margins.  
- Near break-even: many products in the top-50 sit between ~₹1k–₹7k — small swings in returns or ad allocation could push them to loss.  
- Note: result set is top 50 rows (row_limit hit); no brand filter was provided so default brand (Tilting Heads) applied.

Worth checking: break each top product’s net sales, net COGS and allocated ad spend (and return rates) to confirm why some are close to break-even.
